tool.name: marktext_new_untitled_tab
tool.description: Create a new, empty untitled document tab (Untitled-N) in the MarkText editor window and make it the current tab, by calling the editor store's internal NEW_UNTITLED_TAB action in-process.

fn.why: Raw (unwrapped) editor-store action NEW_UNTITLED_TAB({ markdown, selected }) defined at out/renderer/assets/index-DlO1BZCi.js:190677 inside defineStore("editor", ...) (line 189843). Reached through Pinia's wrappedAction closure variable `fn` (Closure (action) scope).

store.why: The reactive editor store (Pinia store id 'editor', index-DlO1BZCi.js:189843); the `this` the action expects (it uses this.tabs, this.SHOW_TAB_VIEW, this.UPDATE_CURRENT_FILE, this.updateTabIdToIndex). Pinia is installed on the Vue app at index-DlO1BZCi.js:207054.

resolution.strategy: Vue app root (#app.__vue_app__) -> globalProperties.$pinia -> _s Map 'editor' -> unwrap reactive Proxy -> Pinia wrappedAction NEW_UNTITLED_TAB -> closure variable fn (the raw action)
resolution.function: NEW_UNTITLED_TAB, out/renderer/assets/index-DlO1BZCi.js:190677, NEW_UNTITLED_TAB({ markdown?: string, selected?: boolean }) -> undefined; called with { selected: true } so markdown defaults to '' (defaultFileStateWithoutId, line 186204-186208)
resolution.execution_context: Renderer main world of the editor window page (index.html?...type=editor#/editor); `this` = the reactive editor store resolved from pinia._s.get('editor') via handle `store`, validated by $id === 'editor'

postcondition.why: Rendered tab strip in the DOM gains exactly one <li> (Vue re-render of the tabs component, index-DlO1BZCi.js ~192780), independent of the store object the adapter checks.
The new tab becomes current, so the native window title changes from 'Untitled-N - MarkText' to 'Untitled-(N+1) - MarkText'; read via Win32 GetWindowText from outside the renderer.
